title: chat.message.deleted
description: A message became a TOMBSTONE. The row is not removed: it keeps its id, its seq and its place in the order, loses its body and attachments, and goes out again under a fresh rev_seq — precisely so that every client cache and offline database learns which id to purge. A row that simply vanished would leave those copies in place forever. Retention of the tombstone is PERMANENT (see stapel-chat MODULE.md).
